entities.summary: Parisa (b. 1950-03-15, Tonekabon) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tonekabon and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, composers & musicians, asia.
